repositoryURL.description: The https URL of the repository to clone. The adapter refuses any other scheme, and refuses a URL carrying embedded credentials (user:token@host) so a secret can never reach the command log.

cloneDirectory.description: Optional folder for the clone, relative to the projects root. Omit it and the folder is derived from the repository name. Whatever is supplied, the adapter re-checks that the resolved path stays inside the projects root, so no relative escape can place a clone elsewhere.
